detail.longDescription: I break down my issue in a generic netbox plugin stub arranged this way: . └── my_plugin_name ├── __init__.py └── template_content.py my_plugin_name/template_content.py is based on template_content.py of NetBox's plugin tests. However, the plugin works for global sites, but not for the given model: class SiteContent(PluginTemplateExtension): models = ['dcim.site'] I adapted the classes in order to just print out invoked class and functions: from netbox.plugins.templates import PluginTemplateExtension from . import MyPlugin import inspect def log_result(classname,funcname): txt = classname+"."+funcname+"()" print("LOG\t"+MyPlugin.name+"\tINFO\t"+txt) return txt class SiteContent(PluginTemplateExtension): models = ['dcim.site'] def head(self): return "<!-- "+log_result(str(type(self).__name__),str(inspect.stack()[0][3]))+" -->" def navbar(self): return log_result(str(type(self).__name__),str(inspect.stack()[0][3])) def buttons(self): return
